budgets.checkpoint: Validation complete-task TRUE rate, then known violation, then earliest update; no heldout choices

collector.fairness: All arms share identical collector trajectories/query pool; no per-arm extra rollout budget
collector.order: Collect train-only S -> theta0 on the fixed U0 S512 subset for5000 updates -> fixed-student visits/F-R labels -> each10000-update arm; total distinct ancestor-plus-adaptation pairs capped1024.
collector.student_actor: F queries bind actual fixed collector student state/visit; one-round state aggregation, not continuously on-policy final-student updates
collector.teacher_takeover: R from teacher takeover keeps real privileged actor provenance; no fabricated student visit/OPD

common.B0: Independent no-time S-only training, same total updates
common.backbone: Small vision-conditioned diffusion transformer; exact source/config pin required before runs
common.cap_failure: Report incomplete common-update comparison, no selective extension
common.harness: Identical safety/submit guard, accepted noncancellable semantics, sensing and calibration
common.information: Same raw event packets/RGB/proprioception/G/capture-execution timestamps for all time-aware arms; only B0 ablates explicit physical time
common.sharing: B2 uses B1 exact weights; common TimeDP theta0 shared for B1/B3/M/ablations; ancestral updates charged equally, actual reuse reported
common.warmstart_manifest: Preselect a source-pinned 512-pair train-only U0 subset of S before collecting F/R. All time-aware checkpoints inherit exactly U0; every final per-arm pool must contain U0 and its union with ancestral data must be <=1024 unique pairs.

budgets.quota_failure: DATA_NOT_READY at fixed cap, no selective extra collection or UNKNOWN imputation
budgets.selection: Fixed stratified train selection; no duplicate F/R pair double counted; withheld data replaced by distinct S, not repeats

claims.claim: Prefix residual event ledger improves complete heldout task/recovery success beyond same-information TimeDP+DAgger under matched caps
claims.falsifier: No M gain beyond B3 or gains only through timer/extra information/budget/rejection

claims.claim: Parameter improvement remains after online teacher and cross-session context/retrieval removed
claims.falsifier: Gain requires online expert/retrieval or vanishes from theta

evaluation.crash: Retain original attempt UNKNOWN/failure with cause, no silent denominator loss
evaluation.hard_negative: Ready packet/open opportunity withheld until original latest event window +50ms; final verifier confirms hard miss, late safe recovery not full success

negative_interpretation.no_gain_B3: DAgger may explain result; no extra ledger algorithm claim

pilot_go.claim: Only go/no-go to a new larger confirmatory preregistration

evaluation.primary: Complete task TRUE divided by all preregistered attempts including hard negatives
evaluation.recoverable: Versioned approach target offset2mm before open, collision-safe bounded reseat while original contract retained
evaluation.statistics: Paired cell/seed effects and per-graph rates;95%world-cell clustered bootstrap;two graph pilot does not prove population task-generalization
evaluation.world_seed: Deterministic cell-to-seed mapping shared across all arms/training seeds

formulation.absolute: TRUE iff onset interval fully <= original D; definitely late FALSE, boundary/missing UNKNOWN; retry cannot move deadline
formulation.architecture: Same diffusion transformer/backbone/reserved ledger channels in all arms; B3 gets same raw public facts but derived ledger slots zero; no new information source
formulation.attempt: Immutable attempt id, graph G, resource B; reset opens new attempt and preserves original denominator

data_semantics.F: Frozen teacher correction queries on delivered actual student-visited failed states, label TEACHER_TARGET_NOT_EXECUTION_SUCCESS; no claim proposal was executed
data_semantics.R: Actual executed recovery tails satisfying v04 known anchors/required APPLIED/typed original failure/independent recovered outcome
data_semantics.S: Known complete successful execution targets with actual future submit/APPLIED and independent outcome
data_semantics.negative: Do not copy failed actions as successful BC

distillation_applicability.FA_OPD: Official method includes PPO reward distillation plus flow action regression; label availability or BC alone does not reproduce it
distillation_applicability.KL: Requires specified tractable density or independently validated score-gradient estimator; not implemented in this stage
distillation_applicability.sample_only: Rule/flow samples support regression/denoising with same action domain, execution-time/state alignment; no invented teacher density or KL from one sample

formulation.dwell: Sampled predicate all TRUE with actual native span>=d; missing/uncertain UNKNOWN, no continuous between-sample claim
formulation.hardcatch: Definitively violated hard deadline/window/strict continuity is absorbing full-task FALSE; later safe handling or local recovery cannot erase

history.offline: Separately declared OFFLINE_CAPTURE; never imply old online delivery
history.online: Only allowed observations actually delivered before decision (native ns,seq)

formulation.loss: E||epsilon-epsilon_theta(alpha_k U_star+sigma_k epsilon,k,h,G,z,T_exec)||^2, same per-pair weight
formulation.new_dwell_identity: New candidate occurrence id linked to original anchor/failure; no overwrite
formulation.policy: TimeDP action chunk at desired future execution times conditioned on causal h,G and deterministic prefix ledger z
formulation.reachability: Full viability set is not solved/proven; unavailable bounds/state remain UNKNOWN
formulation.recoverable: Before open, support/alignment not yet qualified while legal grasp and original constraints/resource remain; at most one reseat/reconfirm
formulation.relative: I_j-I_e=[l_j-u_e,u_j-l_e]; contained TRUE, disjoint FALSE, boundary/missing UNKNOWN
formulation.residual_features: [u_anchor+L-native_now, l_anchor+U-native_now], known dwell span, remaining resource; robust interval empty does not alone prove physical failure
formulation.teacher: One frozen privileged source/payload; private teacher-only inputs isolated, student actor/state digest bound, target after query
formulation.terminology: Supervised student-state DAgger, no implemented OPD/RL claim; visit+teacherquery is data evidence only. OPD does not universally require RL, but this plan has no teacher-distribution/RL update algorithm

labels.late_BC: New timed EXECUTION_OUTCOME/new row_id after audit with lineage to old row and unchanged causal h; no silent schema extension
labels.offline_final: OFFLINE_FINAL_EPISODE_SCORE uses evidence through close in separate namespace; never overwrite early prefix labels or inputs
labels.prefix: V(E_before_label_time_ns_and_seq); known audit anchor arrival must precede label, physical onset is not arrival

limitations: Small pilot no broad heldout statistical guarantee
Components/CPU98/C22 do not prove proposed algorithm

literature.role: Explicit capture/desired execution times already established
Student-generated distillation;RL integration optional,not this robotics algorithm evidence
Diffusion-chain distribution distillation uses explicit distribution/score estimation, not arbitrary rule teacher logprob
Official method separately implements PPO reward distillation and flow-generated action regression

next_native_control.accepted: Never fabricate accepted-command cancellation;late APPLIED/effect retains request identity
next_native_control.controller: Bilateral grasp -> qualified load-ready dwell200ms -> actual open -> stable supported release dwell200ms;one pre-open reseat
next_native_control.gate_failure: Mechanical instrumentation only;load-ready UNKNOWN,no success BC,no method claim
gates: Nonzero effective object gravity, actual mass
Dynamic/kinematic/backend constraint limitation resolved or UNKNOWN
next_native_control.installation: Preserved actual installation with pre/post readback; no hidden mass/gravity changes
next_native_control.prediction: Strong timer may complete 0/150ms with validated measurements/slack;hard failures retain original anchor

routing.reason: Fixed-method one-shot planning; no main-results-supported ablation release or execution

run_order.action: Collect S, train fixed collector theta0, collect shared student-state F/R pool and check quotas; then validation
run_order.stop: Insufficient unique qualified labels at cap

run_order.action: Larger preregistration only after gate;no runs in this increment

heldout.H01: Absolute AND relative AND conditional reseat with original hard anchors
heldout.H02: Pre-open goal dwell AND force dwell AND hard continuity

task_space.materialization: Collision-safe target/pose goal/source/graph manifest pinned before first new control trial; no test outcome tuning
task_space.seen: Old20, paired32, C22 and seen development only explicit legacy-train, never future heldout
task_space.split_unit: Whole graph composition/scenario/parent attempt; every sibling window/recovery/reset descendant stays grouped
task_space.test: No teacher queries/threshold/hparam/checkpoint selection; theta0 snapshots evaluated only after all training choices frozen
task_space.visual: Separate visual perturbation variable, not task-space holdout

two_clocks.physics_latency: Queue waits advance actual native physics; disclose if inference itself pauses physics
two_clocks.virtual: Optional charge ledger separate; never replaced measured native/actual inference

root_review.issue: If theta0 used allS1024, M/B3 would see1536 unique pairs over both stages while claiming1024. Explicit U0=S512 common subset keeps the claimed union budget honest.
root_review.additional_prelaunch_requirement: For nonzero mg load-ready thresholds, per-step active gravity flag must be observed enabled and scene gravity nonzero/qualified; all actual external object wrench and complete force/sign/constraint coverage must be qualified. Disabled or unknown gravity remains diagnostic-only, not supporting a weight-bearing label.
